immutability: This manifest cryptographically seals all evidence artifacts

record.json.purpose: Gate information, test results, and seal decision

qualification.md.purpose: Comprehensive qualification narrative and evidence summary

test-results.json.purpose: Detailed per-test results with exact test names and durations

regression-reconciliation.json.purpose: Classification and analysis of failing NODE-A01 tests

canary-results.json.purpose: Comprehensive plaintext leakage detection results across 13 surfaces

environment.json.purpose: System environment, runtime, and configuration details

manifest_integrity.manifest_digest_instruction: Compute SHA256 hash of this manifest.json file (with all artifact hashes populated) to verify integrity

verification_instructions.step_1: Compute SHA256 hash of each artifact listed in 'artifacts' section
verification_instructions.step_2: Compare computed hashes against 'hash' values in this manifest
verification_instructions.step_3: If all artifact hashes match, compute SHA256 of this manifest.json file
verification_instructions.step_4: Verify signature.txt contains the manifest digest
verification_instructions.step_5: If all match, evidence is verified as unmodified since seal

security_constraints.no_plaintext_secrets: Evidence bundle contains no plaintext secret material
